key_findings: Settlement dynamics DO learn — weights converge, errors decrease

The linear model with bond_order feature (r=0.74) still dominates
The 6 Geometric Primitives carry structural signal, not chemical signal
Bond order is the missing piece — not encoded in element Data Objects
The GLM mind architecture (perceive → interpret → settle) works in principle
The bottleneck is PERCEPTION, not SETTLEMENT — the features need to be richer
